categories.main_business_segments: RIDE ON EXPRESS HOLDINGS operates primarily in the prepared food delivery business, focusing on home delivery of sushi, rice bowls, and other cooked meals. Its main brands include 'Gin no Sara' (sushi delivery), 'Kamatora' (rice bowl delivery), 'Sushi Joto!' (value sushi delivery), and 'Gin no Sara Nagomi' (casual sushi delivery). The company operates both directly managed and franchise stores, with a nationwide network in Japan and a small but growing overseas presence.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages centralized procurement and logistics for fresh ingredients, including exclusive use of high-electric field thawing machines for superior frozen seafood quality. It has developed proprietary order management and delivery systems, and utilizes automated rice cookers for efficient rice bowl preparation. Training centers ensure standardized food preparation and delivery quality across its network.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are households and individuals seeking convenient, high-quality meal delivery, especially for special occasions and daily meals. The company targets a broad demographic, including families, working couples, and single-person households, with a focus on the growing demand for food delivery and takeout in Japan. Its main end markets are domestic consumers, with some expansion into Southeast Asia (notably Thailand).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, with 742 stores and 371 delivery bases nationwide as of March 2025, covering all major regions. It has begun international expansion, with its first overseas store in Bangkok, Thailand, and plans for further overseas growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: RIDE ON EXPRESS operates at the downstream end of the food supply chain, directly interfacing with end consumers through its delivery and franchise networks. It manages procurement, food preparation, and last-mile delivery, while also acting as a franchisor providing know-how, branding, and supply to franchisees.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening profitability through brand quality improvement, operational efficiency, and digital transformation (e.g., enhancing web/app ordering and CRM). The company is investing in new business models, overseas expansion, and sustainability initiatives such as reducing plastic use and adopting electric vehicles. While there is no formal R&D division, innovation focuses on menu development, IT systems, and environmental adaptation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated from direct sales at company-operated stores, franchise royalties (typically 5% of sales), franchise fees, and sales of ingredients and supplies to franchisees. Additional income comes from membership programs, digital points, and limited investment activities. The business is primarily transaction-based, with some recurring revenue from franchise operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other food delivery chains, sushi delivery specialists, and increasingly, large food retailers and restaurant chains entering the delivery market. RIDE ON EXPRESS positions itself as a market leader in sushi delivery, leveraging brand recognition, scale, and operational know-how to maintain high entry barriers. The company faces intensifying competition from both traditional and new entrants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales were ¥23.4 billion, with operating profit of ¥782 million and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥334 million. The company has experienced a slight decline in sales and profit due to store closures and market changes, but maintains a stable financial base with over ¥8 billion in net assets. Growth is currently modest, with a focus on operational optimization and selective expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: RIDE ON EXPRESS emphasizes high-quality, fresh sushi and rice bowls delivered conveniently to homes, supported by proprietary logistics and preparation technologies. Its differentiation lies in brand recognition, exclusive ingredient procurement, efficient multi-brand delivery bases, and a robust franchise system. The company also highlights its ability to offer both premium and value-oriented menu options, catering to a wide range of customer needs.
